optional: arXiv only if the first two require no further setup repair and complete within 30 minutes; otherwise defer without counting it as evaluated or rejected
request_reservation: UTF-8 request byte bound plus overhead; entire max output/thinking ceiling; unknown usage retains full reservation
acceptance: Exact old/new release SHAs; real old tools/list and successful workflow; real new unchanged old invocation fails; native replacement succeeds; no upstream source patches or migration-specific adapter
evidence: Separately hashed synthesis, gate and sealed partitions; existing coordinator denies sealed reads before durable decision
score: Recovered only when a promoted plan preserves all sealed old outputs, independent deterministic oracle checks and read-only filesystem observations; failures are retained
fail_closed: Rejected/inconclusive candidate with no writable-layer changes; generation failure is separately counted and never called a safe rejection
replay: API-free, real historical servers and unchanged verifier/promotion/MCP proxy; compare recorded verdicts and each sealed outcome
frozen_core: No edits to existing core/CLI source, prompts, gates, scoring, 15-case suite, 195 records or realworld-v1 files
